text:
Anya: hi all — first day setup question. I can connect to the bastion over the vpn but after ~2-5 minutes the ssh session hangs and docker pulls to our internal registry stall. Home on xfinity, M1 Macbook. Anyone hit something like this?

Luis: welcome! yep this smells like MTU or VPN split-tunnel weirdness. quick checks: can you reproduce on wired vs wifi? works on office?

Anya: only at home right now, wifi. I tried reconnecting and sometimes it works for a minute then freezes.

Devon: two things to try quickly: lower MTU on the VPN interface, and add SSH keepalives. For mac you can check interfaces: `ifconfig` and look for `utun0` or similar.

Anya: ran `ifconfig utun0` and saw a lot of retransmits in the ifconfig stats. what's the exact mtu command?

Devon: on mac you can set on the active device: `sudo ifconfig utun0 mtu 1400` (temporary) or `networksetup -listallnetworkservices` then `sudo networksetup -setMTU \"Wi‑Fi\" 1400` if the traffic is going via the Wi‑Fi device. Try 1400 then test ssh + docker pull.

Infra-bot: FYI — new-hires onboarding doc has a note about MTU 1500->1400 workaround for consumer ISPs. See https://redwood.internal/onboard/networks (automated message).

Sam: also check SSH client options: add to `~/.ssh/config` for the bastion host: `Host bastion*\n  ServerAliveInterval 30\n  TCPKeepAlive yes\n  IPQoS 0x00` — can help avoid weird drops. For docker problems, ensure internal registry is in NO_PROXY: `export NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,internal.registry.redwood` or set in Docker Desktop settings.

Anya: tried `sudo ifconfig utun0 mtu 1400` and reconnected, ssh stayed stable for 20+ minutes. Docker pull still slow until I added NO_PROXY and restarted docker desktop.

Luis: nice. If this recurs frequently we can pin a policy for the VPN to force MSS clamping, but for now MTU tweak + keepalives is the usual workaround.

Anya: huge thanks all. two quick followups: 1) who do I ping for a permanent change (MSS clamp) in the VPC? 2) can we add the NO_PROXY tip to the onboarding doc?

Devon: ping `infra` on Slack (cc @infra) for the VPC/edge policy change. I'll open a quick PR to the onboarding doc with the NO_PROXY and MTU steps.

Infra-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-4881 — \"Investigate MTU/MSS for consumer VPN clients\" (link: https://redwood.internal/infra/4881)

Anya: awesome, thanks everyone. saving these notes to my onboarding checklist. :party_parrot:
